one_liner: ClickUp has a broad public REST API available on all plans including free, with personal tokens and self-serve OAuth2 apps, plus an official remote MCP server (OAuth-only).
auth_notes: Personal API tokens (pk_ prefix, never expire) for personal use; OAuth2 authorization-code flow for multi-user apps. OAuth apps are created by a Workspace owner/admin in ClickUp API settings; tokens currently do not expire. The MCP server supports OAuth only (no API keys/PATs).
access_notes: Public API available on all plans; some endpoints (user/guest management) are Enterprise-only. Free account can generate a personal token.
blocker_notes: Only minor limits: some endpoints Enterprise-only; OAuth app creation needs Workspace owner/admin.

evidence.quote: For apps or integrations that other people use, use the OAuth flow, allowing users to authorize Workspaces for your app.
Use a personal API token for individual or testing purposes. Personal tokens begin with `pk_`.
Our Public API is available on all [ClickUp Plans](https://clickup.com/pricing) . Some endpoints and parameters are limited by plan.
Anyone with a ClickUp account can generate a personal token.
Connect your AI with ClickUp using our MCP Server.
